tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background — the base layer the glass blur reveals.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Solid fallback behind every glass panel (cards, chart containers) when backdrop-filter isn't available.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Solid fallback for raised glass — sheets, modals, the active tab pill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text — subtitles, helper copy, inactive tab labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text 13px or larger — timestamps, captions, placeholders. Never body copy.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines and non-glass borders — list rows, table rules.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Panel background, always layered over backdrop-filter blur — cards, nav bars, sheets.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge stroke around every glass panel.

tokens.name: glass-specular
tokens.usage: The glint — a small, bright point-source highlight baked into a glass panel's own background (top-left corner, never re-angled), plus the bright top of shadow-glass's bevel and the touch-illumination glow. The single highlight color every glass surface shares; this is what makes the material read as Liquid Glass rather than flat frosted glass.

tokens.name: glass-lens-dark
tokens.usage: The pooled-dark bottom half of shadow-glass's two-tone bevel, opposite the glint's bright top. Stands in for the edge of the panel bending light away from the implied source rather than toward it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary brand coral — primary buttons, active nav icon, logo. Fills and icons 24px+ only; use accent-text for small text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Coral for text and icons under 24px on surface-0/1/2 — links, selected states. Also the focus-ring color.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover state for accent fills.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an accent fill (dark ink reads better on this coral than white, in both themes).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Cyan — maps, routes, GPS traces, distance metrics. Fills and icons 24px+ only; use secondary-text for small text.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Cyan for text and icons under 24px.

tokens.name: secondary-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover state for secondary fills.

tokens.name: ink-on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Gold — personal records, achievement badges, streaks. Fills and icons 24px+ only; use tertiary-text for small text.

tokens.name: tertiary-text
tokens.usage: Gold for text and icons under 24px.

tokens.name: ink-on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a tertiary fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive trend, goal met, pace improvement. Always paired with a checkmark icon or word, never color alone.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success for text and icons under 24px.

tokens.name: ink-on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a success fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Missed goal, sync error, over red-line effort. Reads at 4.5:1 directly as text in both themes. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: ink-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a danger fill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element. Shares accent-text's value.

tokens.name: chart-elevation
tokens.usage: Dataviz series 1 of 6, fixed order, never cycled or reassigned — elevation/altitude line.

tokens.name: chart-pace
tokens.usage: Dataviz series 2 of 6 — pace line. A chart-safe sibling of accent, tuned to clear contrast and colorblind-separation checks.

tokens.name: chart-power
tokens.usage: Dataviz series 3 of 6 — power line.

tokens.name: chart-cadence
tokens.usage: Dataviz series 4 of 6 — cadence line.

tokens.name: chart-heart-rate
tokens.usage: Dataviz series 5 of 6 — heart-rate line.

tokens.name: chart-speed
tokens.usage: Dataviz series 6 of 6 — speed line.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: The baseline a bar/column chart grows from, and an axis line. One step stronger than chart-grid — recessive, not a data color.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines inside a chart plot — a hairline, solid, never dashed. Shares divider's value; same role, chart context.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: De-emphasis gray for an 'emphasis' chart (one series in accent, the rest grayed) and for a folded 'Other' series. A mark color, not a text color — pair with a text-token label, never color the label itself.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Training-load heatmap, step 1 of 5 (near-zero) — allowed to fade toward the surface; a sequential ramp's lightest step reads as 'almost nothing', not as a contrast failure.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 2 of 5.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 3 of 5.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 4 of 5 — shares accent's value.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 5 of 5 (peak) — shares accent-text's light value; brightens further in dark mode so the hottest cell still reads as hottest.

styles.name: metric-hero
styles.usage: The single biggest number on a screen — weekly distance on the dashboard.

styles.name: metric-sm
styles.usage: An inline stat chip or a stat tile's secondary number.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, tab labels, chip text.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Split and lap tables, GPS coordinates.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Compact mono tags — device IDs, timestamps in logs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks inside a chip or tag.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a stat tile's label and its number.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section padding inside a sheet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between major dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page-edge padding on larger screens.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding under a sheet's drag handle.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, chart containers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, modals, the map's floating info card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, the tab bar, avatars.

shadow.note: shadow-glass and shadow-focus carry the glass material's inner sheen and the focus ring; the rest are plain elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, tags.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: List rows, inline cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dashboard cards, stat tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, modals, the map's floating info card.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass panel — drop shadow plus a two-tone inset bevel: a bright top edge and a pooled dark bottom edge, standing in for a lens rim bending light toward the top and away at the bottom.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-pressed
tokens.usage: Interactive glass (buttons, the active tab, a pressed card) at the bottom of its press animation — the panel sits closer to the surface, so the lift shrinks; pair with glass-interactive's scale(.965).

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring glow, paired with the focus-ring border color.

blur.note: Backdrop-filter radii for the glass material. Pair with saturate(180%) contrast(1.05) — see bundle.css — so colors behind the glass concentrate rather than washing gray.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Compact chips and tags that sit on glass.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Standard cards, the tab bar, chart containers.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Full-screen sheets and onboarding overlays.
